info.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX10
info.author: Marc Zischka & Victor Pineda (Veezuhz); FLXXX3
info.description: Pioneer DDJ-FLX10 Mapping v1.1 (Mixxx 2.5 — MIDI controls only, no waveform). FLXXX3: Mixxx pull request 16539, decks 3 and 4 only with 4 DECKS in UTILITY; MASTER and HEADPHONES LEVEL are left to the controller (the app keeps its MASTER HEADROOM).
